description: Change the quantity of an item in your cart. Writes to the chain: this prepares an unsigned transaction (an intent) for `signer`; nothing happens until you sign it with geode-local-signer and submit it with geode_submit_intent.

new_quantity.description: Non-negative integer as a string of digits

signer.description: Your account address (SS58). The transaction is prepared for this account; you sign it on your own machine with geode-local-signer.

name: geode_market_update_cart_item_quantity
title: Market: update cart item quantity
